## What's New
- IntroDB integration — automatic skip prompts for intros, outros, and recaps with a new in-player skip-segment overlay
- Dialogue Enhancement audio effect — clearer speech via center-channel boost and stereo speech-band EQ
- Custom per-folder bookmark sorting, with shareable sort orders via URL scheme
- Redesigned Liquid Glass tab bar (iPad keeps the previous layout)
- New polished sidebar
- EndpointManager — automatic failover between API and CDN endpoints when one is unavailable
- Service Unavailability sheet — clear in-app feedback when the backend is down
- Reorganized Settings, including a dedicated Downloads settings screen
- New audio session configuration for long-form video playback
## Bug Fixes
- Downloads tab badge no longer double-counts HLS downloads
- Marking a season as watched / unwatched now works correctly
- Fixed audio-track selection and the inability to re-watch already-watched offline content (episodes and movies)
- Fixed a navigation bug preventing category opens
- Fixed search badges being too long
- Fixed scrubber behavior in the player
- Corrected server selection path during token refresh
## Other Changes
- Concurrent download cap is now enforced immediately when lowered in settings
- Better placeholder images for posters
- Hero slideshow — smoother animation and simpler swipe action
